correctness.rationale: The fixed-quantile reparameterization reduces the CDF to p=(1+x/(2b))exp(-x), gives an exact implicit derivative for x, and expresses the quantile hazard as a rational function of b and x. Its logarithmic derivative has a denominator of fixed positive sign and a numerator N(b,x) that is positive for all b>1,x>0 by a two-derivative monotonicity argument. At a CEM switch both sides share the same survival probability, so density and hazard jumps have identical signs. The packaged checker independently verifies the formulas and the paper's Figure 1 example.

value.rationale: The parameter ordering alpha1>alpha2 is built into the paper's interpretation of a raised stress, and Proposition 2 calls the rate jump a signature of the harsher stage. The accepted theorem supplies the missing global mathematical guarantee: every such parameter decrease produces an upward failure-rate jump, regardless of change time, and the multi-step direction is completely classified. This gives a direct structural interpretation of the fitted parameter order and rules out accidental sign reversals caused by the IZL model's non-monotone age-wise hazard.
